description: This file defines the AuditLogController class, which provides API endpoints for retrieving audit log entries and daily summary statistics in a REST API. It includes methods for paginated retrieval of entries and daily grouped summaries.

classes.name: AuditLogDailySummary
classes.description: A data transfer object used for summarizing audit logs by date, containing LogDate and Total properties.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles GET requests for paginated audit log entries, supporting page parameter, and returns results with total count and page information.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve daily grouped summaries of audit logs, returning date-wise counts.
